history.message: SUPREME APEX VERIFICATION v653: Added 3+3 new tools to reach 135 total unique tools. Removed duplicates. Transitioned to Version 2.7.9. Verified with 286 tests passing. PR #497.

SUPREME APEX VERIFICATION v649: Added system_net_io_dropout_audit, system_net_io_errin_audit, and system_net_io_errout_audit tools. Transitioned to Version 2.7.5. Verified with all 291 tests passing (268 backend, 16 unit, 7 E2E). PR #493.
